'''Balkin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TERC" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Stormtrooper Commander]] who served [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Empire of the Hand]] as the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of its [[501st Legion (Empire of the Hand)|501st Legion]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC-D">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Balkin attended a strategy session aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' over the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> During the session, he discussed [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s remaining forces and Quethold's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], who insulted the bald man after he asked if the Quesoth [[Midli]] caste was loyal to their [[Queen of the Quesoth|Queen]]. As Balkin and Thrawn had promised that the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the 501st would be able to defeat the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s&mdash;which Nyama considered impossible&mdash;the liaison withdrew the [[Stromma]] from the Empire's service.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

Shortly after, Imperial [[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]] commented to Stromma stormtrooper [[Puriv]] that Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] would kill them both if Balkin did not hear that Puriv and Sanjin had not followed Nyama's directive before him. Shortly after, Thrawn launched an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on Quethold's [[Red City]] in an attempt to kill Esva, during which Balkin reported to the Grand Admiral that Sanjin had lost two of his men.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
